parameters.name: BillOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource ownership account. The resource ownership account is the account that actually uses the resource.

parameters.name: BillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle, in the format of YYYY-MM.

parameters.name: IsHideZeroCharge
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter based on whether the original price (PretaxGrossAmount) is 0. Default value: false (compatible with existing logic). Valid values:
- true: Yes.
- false: No.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of data records to read in this request. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the position from which the next query starts. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning.

parameters.name: RecordID
parameters.description: The order ID or bill ID.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The subscription type. Valid values:
- Subscription: subscription
- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
>  This parameter must be used together with the ProductCode parameter.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type. Valid values:
- SubscriptionOrder: prepaid order
- PayAsYouGoBill: pay-as-you-go bill
- Refund: refund bill
- Adjustment: adjustment bill
